title: Wikipedia Pageviews Curated Religion and Cultural Figures
description: Tracks daily pageviews for a curated list of religion-related and high-cultural-significance Wikipedia articles (Pope figures, religious institutions, major cultural events, papal conclave history, religious reform leaders). Each row reports article title, total pageviews over the past 30 days, average daily views, 7-day-vs-baseline change %, and a momentum tier (SURGING / RISING / STABLE / FALLING). Powers the Religion & Cultural Prediction Brief: pageview spikes on religious figures often precede major cultural events (papal health declines, beatifications, theological controversies) by days-to-weeks. Free Wikimedia REST API, no auth.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta

now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
now_epoch = int(now.timestamp())
end_date = now.strftime('%Y%m%d')
start_date = (now - timedelta(days=30)).strftime('%Y%m%d')

EXPECTED_COLUMNS = [
    'article', 'category',
    'total_views_30d', 'avg_daily_views_30d',
    'recent_7d_views', 'baseline_views_avg',
    'change_7d_vs_baseline_pct',
    'momentum_tier',
    'page_url', '_epoch',
]

CURATED_ARTICLES = [
    {'article': 'Pope_Francis', 'category': 'religion_pope'},
    {'article': 'Pope_Benedict_XVI', 'category': 'religion_pope'},
    {'article': 'Papal_conclave', 'category': 'religion_pope'},
    {'article': 'Vatican_City', 'category': 'religion_pope'},
    {'article': 'Holy_See', 'category': 'religion_pope'},
    {'article': 'Pope', 'category': 'religion_pope'},
    {'article': 'Catholic_Church', 'category': 'religion_christianity'},
    {'article': 'Eastern_Orthodox_Church', 'category': 'religion_christianity'},
    {'article': 'Protestantism', 'category': 'religion_christianity'},
    {'article': 'Dalai_Lama', 'category': 'religion_buddhism'},
    {'article': '14th_Dalai_Lama', 'category': 'religion_buddhism'},
    {'article': 'Buddhism', 'category': 'religion_buddhism'},
    {'article': 'Islam', 'category': 'religion_islam'},
    {'article': 'Mecca', 'category': 'religion_islam'},
    {'article': 'Hajj', 'category': 'religion_islam'},
    {'article': 'Ramadan', 'category': 'religion_islam'},
    {'article': 'Judaism', 'category': 'religion_judaism'},
    {'article': 'Hinduism', 'category': 'religion_hinduism'},
    {'article': 'Diwali', 'category': 'religion_hinduism'},
    {'article': 'Easter', 'category': 'religion_christianity'},
    {'article': 'Christmas', 'category': 'culture_holiday'},
    {'article': 'Lunar_New_Year', 'category': 'culture_holiday'},
    {'article': 'Mother_Teresa', 'category': 'religion_figure'},
    {'article': 'Billy_Graham', 'category': 'religion_figure'},
    {'article': 'Yom_Kippur', 'category': 'religion_judaism'},
]

def classify_momentum(change_pct):
    if change_pct is None:
        return 'STABLE'
    if change_pct >= 100:
        return 'SURGING'
    if change_pct >= 25:
        return 'RISING'
    if change_pct <= -50:
        return 'FALLING'
    return 'STABLE'

rows = []
for ai in range(len(CURATED_ARTICLES)):
    ent = CURATED_ARTICLES[ai]
    article = ent['article']
    category = ent['category']
    url_path = (
        'https://wikimedia.org/api/rest_v1/metrics/pageviews/per-article'
        '/en.wikipedia.org/all-access/all-agents/' + article + '/daily/'
        + start_date + '/' + end_date
    )
    try:
        resp = requests.get(
            url_path,
            headers={'User-Agent': 'SpeakesQuery research bot (noreply@speakesquery.local)'},
            timeout=30,
        )
        resp.raise_for_status()
        payload = resp.json() or {}
        items = payload.get('items', []) or []
    except Exception:
        continue
    if not items:
        continue
    daily = []
    for ii in range(len(items)):
        it = items[ii]
        if not isinstance(it, dict):
            continue
        v = it.get('views', 0) or 0
        try:
            daily.append(int(v))
        except Exception:
            continue
    if not daily:
        continue
    total_30d = sum(daily)
    avg_daily = total_30d / len(daily) if daily else 0
    recent_7 = daily[-7:] if len(daily) >= 7 else daily
    baseline = daily[:-7] if len(daily) > 7 else daily
    recent_7_total = sum(recent_7)
    recent_7_avg = recent_7_total / len(recent_7) if recent_7 else 0
    baseline_avg = sum(baseline) / len(baseline) if baseline else 0
    change_pct = None
    if baseline_avg > 0:
        change_pct = round((recent_7_avg - baseline_avg) / baseline_avg * 100.0, 2)
    momentum = classify_momentum(change_pct)
    page_url = 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/' + article
    rows.append({
        'article': article,
        'category': category,
        'total_views_30d': total_30d,
        'avg_daily_views_30d': round(avg_daily, 1),
        'recent_7d_views': recent_7_total,
        'baseline_views_avg': round(baseline_avg, 1),
        'change_7d_vs_baseline_pct': change_pct,
        'momentum_tier': momentum,
        'page_url': page_url,
        '_epoch': now_epoch,
    })

if rows:
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=EXPECTED_COLUMNS)
    df = df.sort_values('total_views_30d', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
else:
    df = pd.DataFrame(columns=EXPECTED_COLUMNS)

GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
